props.gloss_en: the mishna: a donkey goes out with a saddlecloth when it is tied to it
Shmuel: [the mishna's permission holds] provided it was tied to it from Shabbat eve
the later mishna: the donkey does not go out with a saddlecloth when it is not tied to it
the later mishna speaks of a saddlecloth not tied at all
the later mishna speaks of a saddlecloth not tied from Shabbat eve
the baraita: a donkey goes out with a saddlecloth when it was tied to it from Shabbat eve
the baraita: and not with a saddle, even though it was tied to it from Shabbat eve
RSBG: even with a saddle when it was tied to it from Shabbat eve -- provided he does not tie the masrichan to it and does not pass a strap under its tail
placing a saddlecloth on a donkey on Shabbat is permitted
the baraita: a saddle that is on a donkey -- he may not move it with his hand
the baraita: rather he walks it back and forth in the courtyard and it falls of itself
R' Zeira: leave him -- he holds like his teacher [Rav]
Rav: one hangs a traskal on an animal on Shabbat
Shmuel: a traskal is prohibited
Shmuel: if Abba [Rav] said so, he knows nothing at all of Shabbat matters
R' Zeira: well said, and so Aryokh explained it in Babylonia
Aryokh -- who is he? Shmuel
Rav Pappa: here [the saddlecloth] is to warm it, there [the saddle] to cool it; for warming it has pain, for cooling it has no pain
the folk saying: a donkey is cold even in the Tammuz season
the Tosefta: nor foals with traskalin in their mouths into the public domain
the Tosefta: nor [an animal] with an amulet, even if it is proven
no: [the Tosefta's foals are] small ones, and [the traskal is] because of pain

objections.gloss_en: וכי מה בין זה לאוכף? -- he was silent (אישתיק). איתיביה: a saddle on a donkey may not be moved by hand; השתא ליטול אמרת לא, להניח מיבעיא -- so how can placing a saddlecloth be permitted?

answered_by.gloss_en: שבקיה, כרביה סבירא ליה -- leave him; he holds like his teacher Rav, who permits the saddlecloth a fortiori from the traskal (= p_rav_chiyya_kerabei)

objections.gloss_en: והא רב נמי אמרה? -- Rav too permitted the saddlecloth, so why credit Aryokh (Shmuel) alone?

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא שמעיה דהוה מסיים בה: ואין תולין טרסקל בשבת -- he heard him conclude that one does not hang a traskal, and to that he said 'so Aryokh explained'

objections.gloss_en: דכולי עלמא מיהת מרדעת מותר, מאי שנא מאוכף? -- all agree the saddlecloth is permitted; how is it different from the saddle, which may not even be removed?

answered_by.gloss_en: שאני התם דאפשר דנפיל ממילא -- there it is different, since it can fall of itself
כאן לחממה, כאן לצננה -- warming relieves pain, cooling does not (= p_rav_pappa_lechamema)

objections.gloss_en: מיתיבי... ולא סייחים בטרסקלין שבפיהם לרשות הרבים -- לרשות הרבים הוא דלא, הא בחצר שפיר דמי; מאי לאו בגדולים ומשום תענוג?! (53a.14)

answered_by.gloss_en: לא, בקטנים ומשום צער -- no: small foals, and because of pain (= p_syachim_ketanim_tzaar)
